mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in a month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in a single month
failure_condition: Over 30 such FEDFUNDS spikes, 20-day forward returns remain positive or flat, and IC > 0.05 in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payrolls surprise exceeding +100k with unemployment falling below 5% predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market strength supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Over 20 such events, 60-day forward returns are not statistically outperforming the prior month's returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in homebuilding activity (HOUST) of at least 10% for two consecutive months predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals resilient consumer demand for housing.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by ≥10% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Repeated HOUST spikes fail to precede positive 20-day returns in 70% of cases across multiple cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) falling below 95 for three consecutive months indicates softening supply constraints, which tends to depress equity valuations and produce negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Three consecutive INDPRO < 95 months without a subsequent negative 20-day return, or IC > 0.10 in walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly rises by more than 0.5% in a month, it reflects inflationary pressure that tends to depress 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 10 such CPIAUCSL spikes, 60-day forward returns are not persistently negative (IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% without a corresponding rise in payrolls suggests a tight labor market that can drive equity risk premia higher, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS does not exceed +50,000 in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market tightening without wage growth
failure_condition: More than 8 such UNRATE drops fail to precede negative 20-day returns (p-value > 0.05 in out-of-sample).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in retail sales proxy (not available in the given catalog; fallback: use RSAFS for industrial demand) below 350 billion suggests weakening demand, which is associated with negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 15 such RSAFS declines, 60-day forward returns do not show persistent underperformance (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and homebuilding (HOUST) both fall by at least 5% in the same month, it indicates dual supply-side pressures that tend to produce positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as market expectations adjust downward.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by ≥5% AND HOUST decreases by ≥5% in the same month
failure_condition: More than 12 such dual declines do not precede positive 20-day returns (IC < 0.03 in walk-forward).
